sentences.text: 2. Both parties are willing to settle their disputes.
3. Mr. Shikhar Goel, petitioner in person, submits that he seeks visitation rights with his child twice a month and quashing of the FIR filed under Section 498A of the Indian Penal Code, 1860.
Subject to the aforesaid being granted, he is agreeable to a divorce by mutual consent.

4. Counsel for the respondent wife submits that the respondent is agreeable to quashing of the FIR,
provided a divorce by mutual consent is granted and reasonable amount is paid towards maintenance along with return of her streedhan/jewellery.
5. It is submitted by the petitioner that the streedhan/jewellery has already been retuned.
6. Taking into account the aforesaid submissions, the Court is of the view that the matter can be resolved between the parties.

The parties are referred to mediation before the Delhi High Court Mediation and Conciliation Centre (DHCMC).
7.

entities.text: Delhi High Court Mediation and Conciliation Centre
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Both parties submit that a senior mediator with expertise in matrimonial matters be appointed in the present case.
Accordingly, DHCMC is requested to appoint Ms. Veena Ralli, Advocate to act as a mediator in the present case.
8. Parties shall appear before the DHCMC on 21st November, 2023 at 4.00 PM.
9. The Investigating Officer (IO) shall submit a Report with regard to return of streedhan/jewellery by the petitioner to the respondent, to the learned Mediator within fifteen days.
10. Both the parties agree that they shall not question the Report submitted by the IO in this regard.
This is a digitally signed order.

I am informed that the appeal filed by the petitioner against the judgment passed by the learned Metropolitan Magistrate under Section 12 of the Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act,
2005 is listed before the Appellate Court on 6th December, 2023.

13.
Till the next date of hearing, the petitioner shall continue to pay a composite amount of Rs.77,000/- per month to the respondent for the months of November, December and January.
Subject to the petitioner paying the aforesaid amount, no coercive action shall be taken against the petitioner.

Subject to the aforesaid being granted, he is agreeable to a divorce by mutual consent.
